description: FM1 diagnostic firmware, module configuration and custom firmware projects through the hosted Forge plugin panel.

interface.defaultPrompt: Open my FM1 App Library and check the connection and available apps.
interface.longDescription: Install the diagnostic baseline, test controls, LCD and audio, configure USB/system and user modules graphically, and ask Codex to build a custom firmware project. The native panel has a plain black default, optional colours and saved transfer progress. Serial-to-UBOOT and direct UBOOT use validated private application packages; official .fwsc/SysEx updates use the vendor updater.

name: fm1-app-library
